Marta (CS): dropping a short go-live prefetch + streaming handshake for the handoff with product teams. aim: avoid cold starts during demo->prod, keep token cost reasonable, and capture feedback that maps to renewal risk. want eng + SE sign-off. TL;DR: enable prefix caching, short TTL for onboarding orgs, streaming on interactive routes, and a lightweight feedback pulse in-demo.

Jamal (Eng-SRE): quick skim — overall 👍. notes: prefer cache_ttl 15m for high-variance onboarding orgs, max_batch_latency ~ 25ms for interactive routes, set streaming_initial_chunk_tokens=64 so demo UX is snappy. add fallback to a quantized variant when queue depth > 70%. also add a watchdog to revert cache if error rate spikes.

Priya (Solutions Eng): will add copy + SDK snippets for customers. add telemetry flags so we capture: token_count, avg_latency_ms, streaming_chunk_count, and a "renewal_risk" tag we can set from CS feedback. also recommend a tiny prefill script customers can run to warm the KV cache with 50 typical prefixes.

Marta (CS): Runbook snippet for CS handoff (customer-facing steps, short and actionable):
- Preflight: verify billing & API key, confirm model selection + SLA expectations.
- Warmup: run 50 synthetic requests that mirror demo prompts (include embeddings/rerank calls if used).
- Cache: enable prefix cache with TTL=15m (config below) and confirm cache hits > 60% after warmup.
- Streaming: enable streaming for first N tokens (64) and verify chunked rendering in demo client.
- Batch: set max_batch_latency=25ms for interactive routes; verify p95 latency meets target.
- Fallbacks: configure fallback_model (quantized) for capacity pressure + confirm fallback telemetry.
- Feedback: trigger a 1-question in-demo pulse: "Was the result helpful? (yes/no)" + optional free text; log response to customer metadata & mark renewal_risk if negative.

Marta (CS): sample customer curl (paste in docs):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\
  -d '{"model":"redwood/open-14b","prompt":"<demo prompt>","stream":true,"cache_prefix":"org-{{ORG_ID}}/demo","batch_window_ms":20}'
```

Priya (Solutions Eng): sample route config for docs (YAML snippet):
```
route_config:
  max_batch_latency_ms: 25
  cache_ttl_sec: 900   # 15 minutes for onboarding orgs
  streaming_initial_chunk_tokens: 64
  fallback_model: "redwood/open-14b-quant"
```

Jamal (Eng-SRE): ops checklist for CS handoff (internal):
- run warmup job (script in repo) against customer's pinned model
- confirm cache hit rate & KV sizing
- enable canary streaming path for 10% of demo traffic
- monitor error_rate and token_cost for first 72h
- if error_rate > 2% rollback streaming and open a SRE ticket

Marta (CS): capture plan for renewal signal + feedback flow:
- CS collects in-demo pulse + follow-up NPS at day 7
- flag negative pulses as "renewal_risk" in account metadata
- automatic triage: if renewal_risk && token_spike > 30% => schedule enablement session + SE deep-dive

Ethan (CSM): assigning owners: Marta -> customer enablement checklist + in-demo pulse content; Priya -> SDK/curl examples in docs; Jamal -> ops checklist + canary deploy config; I'll follow up with customer kickoff calendar invite.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for route "demo-interactive" (canary=10%, image=redwood/open-14b@sha256:abc123) :rocket:

Marta (CS): thanks all — can we aim to ship the customer-facing mini-runbook into the onboarding doc pages today? small step: publish and share to customer 1 hour before kickoff. :white_check_mark:

Jamal (Eng-SRE): I'll push the canary config by EOD, will ping once done.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll add the SDK code and sample warmup script to the docs repo and link it here.

Marta (CS): perfect. will close the loop once the customer confirms the in-demo pulse works and we see cache hits.
